scripts.restart:app: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } }" && npm run build && npm start
scripts.restart:dev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ports = 3000,3001; $p = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $ports -contains $_.LocalPort } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } }" && npm run dev
